Version 1.0.2

- Internal user identity handling is now fully automatic; users are never asked to input or view any ID or sensitive parameter.
- All prompts, documentation, and usage instructions have been revised to remove references to user/manual open-id acquisition.
- Scripts and API calls internally manage identity initialization and association; process for report listing and analysis is simplified for the user.
- Removed documentation and flows prompting the user for usernames or phone numbers.
- Minor documentation cleanup and removal of obsolete files.

- Adjusted open-id config file search logic: now first checks scripts/config.yaml in the skill's own directory, then checks the workspace public config directory.
- Updated file paths and parameter descriptions in documentation to match new config.yaml location.
- Minor text and formatting fixes for clarity in operating steps and constraints.
- Added license metadata to SKILL.md.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md documentation file.

Initial release of AI-powered pet vomiting and regurgitation detection & analysis.

- Detects vomiting and regurgitation actions in pets from indoor fixed-camera video using motion and vomitus recognition.
- Identifies rhythmic abdominal contractions, head-forward extension, and mouth opening; distinguishes vomitus types (food, hairball, bile).
- Records event time, frequency, and vomitus characteristics for early digestive issue discovery.
- Supports historical report queries with strict cloud data retrieval and user open-id enforcement.
- Designed for home health monitoring, multi-pet households, senior pet care, and inpatient animal hospital observation.
